UI polish.

## Changed

- **Reactive edge on the result & download windows.** The share-result panel and
  the download page now light up their gold hairline border with a soft glow on
  hover, matching the drop zone's interactive feel (`app/globals.css`).
- **Simpler wording.** The result window heading now just says "Your link is
  ready" instead of "share link" (`lib/i18n/locales/en.ts`, `de.ts`).

## Fixed

- **Init-log banner.** Removed the stray separator rule printed above the ASCII
  banner and added breathing room between the banner and the title block
  (`print-banner.sh`).
